# TradeJS Documentation

> Documentation for the TradeJS TypeScript framework: build, backtest, and run programmable trading strategies with a self-hosted runtime.

Docs home: https://docs.tradejs.dev
Russian docs: https://docs.tradejs.dev/ru/
Marketing site: https://tradejs.dev

## MCP

TradeJS MCP connects Codex and Claude Code through OAuth and Streamable HTTP at /mcp. Read markets, charts, runtime strategies/signals/orders and verified evidence; run bounded cached backtest/diagnostic jobs through a separate worker. Requires an MCP-enabled release. No live order or deployment tools. Guide: https://docs.tradejs.dev/guides/mcp (Russian: https://docs.tradejs.dev/ru/guides/mcp). The project owner can inspect data coverage, request gap downloads with market:backfill, and read saved studies with research:read.

Separately installed strategies outside Base: TradingPatterns (https://docs.tradejs.dev/strategies/reference/trading-patterns) VwapReversion (https://docs.tradejs.dev/strategies/reference/vwap-reversion), and RangeReclaim (https://docs.tradejs.dev/strategies/reference/range-reclaim). TradingPatterns supports 15-minute and hourly candles (hourly by default). LondonBreakout (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tradejs/strategy-london-breakout) and TrendPullback (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tradejs/strategy-trend-pullback) are also published separately.

Other standalone strategies:
- Crab (https://docs.tradejs.dev/strategies/reference/crab)
- Diamond (https://docs.tradejs.dev/strategies/reference/diamond)
- Triangle (https://docs.tradejs.dev/strategies/reference/triangle)
- ValueAreaReclaim (https://docs.tradejs.dev/strategies/reference/value-area-reclaim)
- ImbalanceMomentum (https://docs.tradejs.dev/strategies/reference/imbalance-momentum)

## Automatic fixed-configuration research

Use research:strategy or the strategy-research skill with Node.js 24. Cached USDT studies freeze filters and directions on DEV before TEST, support resume and frozen-period revalidation, and produce verified HTML/JSON records. Configured Jev uses saved assessments or local models for a frozen with/without comparison. No live orders, publication or deployment. See https://docs.tradejs.dev/guides/codex-strategy-skills and https://docs.tradejs.dev/api/cli#automatic-strategy-research.

## Entry submission and replay diagnostics

Before entry submission, TradeJS checks Bybit’s quote and the final quantity; estimated loss above MAX_LOSS_VALUE produces a warning. Runtime debug also controls delivery of the verified live/replay comparison. See https://docs.tradejs.dev/runtime/execution/signals and https://docs.tradejs.dev/runtime/execution/telegram-notifications.

Mixed-timeframe replay evaluates each strategy on its own closed candles and can record the replay decision for an unmatched live entry. See https://docs.tradejs.dev/runtime/backtesting/replay-evidence.
